tool_schemas.description: Current version per region, health and error rate of a service.

tool_schemas.name: list_deployments
tool_schemas.description: Release history for a service with health status (oldest first).

tool_schemas.name: rollback
tool_schemas.description: Roll a service back to a previously released version in all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: deploy
tool_schemas.description: Deploy a version of a service to all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: create_incident
tool_schemas.description: Open an incident; this pages the on-call engineer.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome. Reuse the key when retrying the same request.

trace.error_message: Rollout halted after us-east: orchestrator error

args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of about 18%. v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging. I rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt stopped after us-east because of an orchestrator error, which left the regions on mixed versions. A retry completed the rollback in all regions. Current state: all regions on v2.3.0, service healthy, error rate about 0.2%. Follow-up: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure, look into the orchestrator error during the rollback, and ask why v2.3.1 was promoted to production when its rc was unhealthy in staging.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and the service is healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.1 was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an 18% error rate. v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt stopped after us-east because of an orchestrator error, so I retried it and the second attempt finished all regions. Now every region is on v2.3.0, the service is healthy and the error rate is 0.2%. No approval was needed because v2.3.0 had been healthy in production before.
- **Incident:** The first request to open INC-0001 timed out. I retried with the same key so it couldn't create a duplicate. The incident description covers the failure, both rollback attempts, the current state and these follow-ups:
  - Find out why v2.3.1 failed.
  - Look into the orchestrator error during the rollback.
  - Ask why v2.3.1 went to production when its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) was already unhealthy in staging.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
The rollback stopped partway: us-east is on v2.3.0, but us-west and eu-west are still on v2.3.1. I'll retry the rollback once to finish those two regions.
